stories.title: ECP sets Feb 7 as polling date for first phase of Punjab local govt elections; KP polls delayed
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) on Thursday decided to hold the first phase of local government elections in Punjab on Feb 7, 2027, in view of fog and weather conditions, while polls in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa were postponed until further orders.

stories.title: FCC bars PHC from hearing cases related to PTI workers' preventive detention
stories.brief: The FCC restrained the high court from proceeding further on the cases and decided to issue notices to the parties with a direction that they may also file their pleas before the superior court.

stories.title: ECP announces February 7 for Punjab LG polls, suspends K-P election process
stories.brief: A four-member bench headed by Chief Election Commissioner Sikandar Sultan Raja heard the case concerning local government elections in Punjab. The Punjab chief secretary informed the commission that preparations for the local government elections had been completed.

stories.title: Federal Constitutional Court bars Peshawar High Court from hearing MPO detention cases
stories.brief: The Federal Constitutional Court (FCC) on Thursday barred the Peshawar High Court (PHC) from hearing cases concerning arrests under the Maintenance of Public Order (MPO) Ordinance until further orders in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P). During today's proceedings, a two-member bench headed by Chief Justice Aminuddin Khan heard a petition filed by the K-P government.

stories.title: William meets firefighters who tackled summer blazes
stories.brief: The prince says 2026 was the first summer he felt "worried about the scale of the wildfires".

stories.title: Prince William says UK faces terrifying risk of more wildfires due to climate change
stories.brief: The prince says 2026 was the first summer he felt "worried about the scale of the wildfires".

stories.title: PM directs cancellation of petrol pump licences over failure to facilitate fuel subsidy beneficiaries
stories.brief: The meeting was informed that 15,519,282 citizens had registered under the subsidy scheme so far, including 15.06 million motorcycle owners and 449,000 owners of vehicles with engine capacities of up to 800cc. PM Shehbaz announced a relief scheme in September for owners of motorcycles, rickshaws and vehicles with engine capacities of up to 800cc.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz orders cancellation of petrol pump licences over denial of fuel subsidies
stories.brief: Shehbaz directed the relevant authorities to ensure that registered beneficiaries faced no hurdles in obtaining subsidised fuel and that petrol pumps complied with the government's instructions. On September 14, the Economic Coordination Committee of the Cabinet had set aside Rs75 billion for the Prime Minister's Fuel Relief Scheme.

stories.title: Elon Musk’s nearly half a billion dollars in midterms spending was a flop
stories.brief: The tech billionaire set spending record as he poured $446m into campaigns for failed Republican candidatesElon Musk set a record for election spending this year after pouring nearly half a billion dollars into backing Republicans in the US midterm elections. He outdid his own 2024 spending of nearly $290m.

stories.title: Typhoons batter East Asia as El Niño makes Pacific 'burn with fever'
stories.brief: Even for countries where typhoons are a way of life, the last few months have brought unusually wild weather.

stories.title: Elon Musk's millions failed to deliver Republican wins in fierce midterms
stories.brief: Musk spent nearly $500m in the 2026 US midterm elections, an individual election spending record.

stories.title: Governor Kundi vows to prioritise KP’s security, uplift
stories.brief: DERA ISMAIL KHAN: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Governor Faisal Karim Kundi on Wednesday said that the fight against terrorism remained the top priority of the provincial government, followed by efforts to ensure the restoration of peace and bring prosperity to the province.

stories.title: Chief Ministers Bugti, Maryam agree on joint efforts for safe cities in Balochistan
stories.brief: QUETTA: Balochistan Chief Minister Mir Sarfraz Bugti and his Punjab counterpart Maryam Nawaz have agreed to strengthen cooperation to make Safe City projects in Balochistan more effective, operational and aligned with modern security requirements.

stories.title: FCC rejects JUI-F appeal against election of its own lawmaker
stories.brief: During the hearing, counsel for JUI-F informed the court that the party had submitted four names for reserved seats. The counsel argued that the ECP could not make changes to the list submitted by a political party for reserved seats. “This is a unique case in Pakistan's history,” the JUI-F lawyer said.

stories.title: North Korea says it tested advanced air-defence missile system
stories.brief: Gen. Kim Jong Sik, a member of the Central Military Commission, on Wednesday guided the test-fire, which aimed at confirming the technical specifications of the air-defence missile system, KCNA reported.

stories.title: At least one killed, two injured as portion of building collapses in Karachi
stories.brief: At least one person died, and two others were injured after a portion of a two-storey building collapsed near the New Nazimabad Flyover on Manghopir Road in Karachi, Rescue 1122 said on Thursday.

stories.title: Countering terrorism top priority, says Kundi
stories.brief: Addressing local elders and prominent figures in Dera Ismail Khan after chairing a high-level meeting, the governor said he had received briefings from various government departments on law and order, security arrangements, administrative affairs and ongoing development projects.

stories.title: Punjab to support Balochistan's Safe City projects
stories.brief: Balochistan Chief Minister Sarfraz Bugti and his Punjab counterpart Maryam Nawaz have agreed to strengthen Safe City projects in Balochistan through joint initiatives, institutional cooperation and technical support to bring them in line with modern security requirements.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia extends $3 billion loan rollover
stories.brief: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said on Wednesday that Saudi Arabia has further extended the $3 billion debt repayment for a 'reasonable period' and said that the country's external position remains comfortable even without a $10 billion US facility.

stories.title: Three ways the interest rate rise could affect you
stories.brief: Job, loans and savings are all affected by the rise in interest rates announced by the Bank of England.
